reviews.x: Murray & Lanman's Florida Water (now made by Lanman & Kemp-Barclay & Co.) has a long history. It was first introduced for sale in 1808, an American-made version of Eau de Cologne (aka Cologne Water) originally from Cologne, Germany (Köln). The colorful label hearkens back to its beginnings; in fact, the label is little-changed from its earliest days. reviews.t: Love this stuff and so do my kids
reviews.x: I purchased this to use in my cleansing rituals around my home/work/car.  My oldest son loved it so much he uses it as his cologne everyday.  It's not too strong and does not stick around too long.  For cleansing rituals I dilute it with distilled or holy water and put into a spray bottle.  I also put a little in a hot salt bath soak to give it a nice fragrance.  However, it was a little cheaper at CVS than Amazon so if you have a drug store close then you might want to check that out first.

I had wanted to know what this stuff smelled like for ages!  Now I use it all the time! Its a refreshing and romantic scent that makes me think of by-gone days in the sweltering hot south.  I use it as an after bath splash and sometimes add it to my bath water.  It also makes a good perfume.  And its a little spooky since some people use it for magical rituals.  A unique historical scent with a fascinating history.

I just plain like this stuff.  The smell doesn't overwhelm, or last too long, but talk about astringent after shower and shave. I hose off on my patio after yard work about 3 times a day, and I keep a bottle of this Florida Water on the back porch to use after each hosedown. You'd have to be a guy to understand.

I remember my grandmother doing her spiritial ceremonies every year, for the Saints or for the birthday of the native Indian spirit burn a cigar and smoke some and blow it on us , just an over around Puerto Rican ritual.This smell is perfect in a hot tub and I spray my house with it can't live without it.A+

reviews.t: Great for personal scent or spiritual cleansing
reviews.x: I love this scent.  I bought it for magical pursuits, mainly to clear negativity from myself and my environment.  I've used it though for everyday wear.  It's not too feminine or masculine.  It's just perfect and very reasonably priced here.

My Dad was very old school Greek and Florida Water was one of his favorite scents. I always keep a bottle around. The scent is fresh and clean and lively w/o being cloying. It doesn't seem to be in great use among the younger generations, so you can have a unique fragrance for pennies!

Many customers use it for spiritual cleansing rituals, clearing bad energy, and blessing spaces.
Several reviewers value it as an affordable, inexpensive product.
Some reviewers note the scent is not too strong and does not last long.
